runs.text: One of the strongest warnings of the Bible tells us that in the end times, amidst deceptions of every kind, God’s people will give three distinct messages to warn the world of God’s coming judgments.
These messages are described as three angels flying in the midst of heaven. These messages are a call from God to the last generation, to repent, to turn back to God, and to “
worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters” (Rev 14:7).
There are two locations in the Bible where these messages are found. (See Revelation 14:6-12; Revelation 18:1-24)
THE THREE ANGELS:
1. What did John see flying in the midst of heaven?
Revelation 14:6
And
I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven
having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth
, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people.
Note:

The word angel means “messenger”. (See Strong’s) There are not three literal angels streaking across the sky. Instead, there are three distinct messages giving the everlasting gospel of salvation in Christ verses a last warning to those who dwell upon the earth. In this study, we will address these messages.
FIRST ANGEL… JUDGMENT IS COME:
2. What does the angel say “is come”?
Revelation 14:7
Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him;
for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
Note:
What is happening here? In the days just prior to the second coming of Jesus, God is judging individuals and nations. When Christ returns, His reward is with Him.
Revelation 22:12 “And behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.”

If Christ’s reward is with Him, then before Jesus returns, there has to have been some type of a pre-advent judgment. The first angel’s message is an announcement that God’s judgment has begun. (See Revelation 14:7) Within the verse of Revelation 14:7, it says we are to: “
worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.”
This is a quote from the Ten Commandments. Exodus 20:11
“For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it
.” This means that this last-day message from God will include a call to honor His Sabbath day.
These messages are warnings from a loving Father who wishes for all to repent and accept the “
everlasting gospel.
” (See Revelation 14:6) These messages are a wake-up call. God loves His people and sends warnings to awaken them from their slumber.
3. After we hear of nations and kingdoms rising up in wars, what are other signs that the end is near?
Luke 21:9
But
when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and
pestilences
and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
Note:

During the time of the end, the devil creates fearful famines, earthquakes, and pestilences. God allows these events to awaken His people. Today we see engineered food shortages and famines beginning to surface.
Since 2002 we have seen worldwide pandemics (
pestilences

), each one growing worse, yet each one being laced with the mercy of a loving God. Pestilences will grow worse in the future. These are signs showing that Jesus is coming soon, and that God’s judgment has begun. (See also Luke 21:25-26)
SECOND ANGEL… BABYLON IS FALLEN:
4. What did the angel come down from heaven with?
Revelation 18:1
And after these things
I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory
And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen.
Note:
The second angel’s message comes with great power, exclaiming that Babylon is fallen!
WHO, OR WHAT IS BABYLON?

To answer this question, we must briefly look at the gods that ancient Babylon worshiped. We will then compare the gods of ancient Babylon with the errors taught about God in today’s church. We will discover whether the false gods of Babylon fit the errors of today’s church. We will see if today’s church has fallen because she has adopted Babylon’s errors, and rejected truth.
5. What did the ancient people of the plains build?
Genesis 11:4
And they said, Go to,
let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven;
and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
Note:

After the flood, the city of Babylon, and the Tower of Babel were built by Nimrod. It was built in opposition to God. It was thought that if they built a high tower whose top would reach unto heaven, it would then be above the level of Noah’s flood. The Babylonians did this, thinking that God could not destroy them by a flood a second time.
What did Nimrod become?
Genesis 10:8
And Cush begat Nimrod:
he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
Note:
Nimrod was the leader of Babylon. He and his wife Semiramis had a child named Tammuz.
These three were proclaimed gods by the people of Babylon
. This then became the foundation of sun worship.
7. How did God scatter the people of Babel abroad upon the face of the earth?
Genesis 11:9
Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because
the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
Note:
When God saw what the people of ancient Babylon had done in building the tower, He confused (
confounded

) their language. As the people of Babylon were building the tower, suddenly their languages changed. Suddenly they were unable to communicate with each other. This stopped the construction of the tower and they were scattered unto all parts of the earth. Each one was scattered with others of his own language group.
Their languages were changed, but they all retained the worship of the three gods of Babylon. Each of these people groups still worshiped
Nimrod, Semiramis, and Tammuz
. Their languages called the gods of Babylon by different names, but the three-god concept remained.
Greece
= Zeus - Dionysus - Aphrodite,
Rome
= Jupiter - Attis - Cybele/Diana,
Egypt
= Ra - Horus - Isis,
India
= Vishnu - Krishna - Isi Devaki.

Later on, as Christianity spread into the areas of dispersed Babylon, the Christians there often became corrupted by the three-god teachings of Babylon. This false concept of God has continued down through the ages. This is one of the reasons that the Bible identifies the fallen church of the end of time as Babylon.
ISRAEL WORSHIPED BABYLON’S FALSE GOD:
8. Which false gods did Israel worship?
Ezekiel 8:14
Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and, behold,
there sat women weeping for Tammuz
. 16 And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD,
between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
Note:

Israel often entered into apostasy by worshipping Babylon’s gods. Here the women of Israel were found weeping for Tammuz. Tammuz is the son of Nimrod and was worshiped as the reincarnation of his father. (Tammuz was born on December 25th.)

The elders were doing something much worse. The elders turned their backs on the temple of the Lord and were engaged in the abomination of sun worship. Sun worship was the worship of Nimrod as the sun-god.

This three-god heresy of Babylon has led the end-time Christian church into a subtle form of idolatry. In the worship of the false triune god, the Christian church has followed after the sins of Babylon. This is one of the reasons that the Bible identifies the fallen church of the end of times as Babylon.
9. How many false gods did Judah worship?
Jeremiah 11:13
For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah
Note:
When the worship of Babylon’s god came into Christianity, the worship of three gods; father, mother, and child was morphed into Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. The Bible
does teach
that there is a Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, but it
does not teach that they are 3 Gods
The Bible never calls the Holy Spirit, “God the Holy Spirit”. Instead, it calls he Holy Spirit the “Spirit
of
God,” or the “Spirit
of
Christ.” The devil has made a counterfeit appear so close to the true that only the discernment of Elijah can spot the difference. Alexander Hislop, in his book
The Two Babylons
(page 139), claims that Semiramis, a legendary figure associated with Babylon, was transformed into a dove and identified as the "Mother" with a divine spirit.
A simple Google search for the words, “
female holy spirit

” reveals that the three-in-one-god of Christianity often includes the heresy of a female (mother) holy spirit. So, we see that the three false gods concept of Babylon has indeed reached its tentacles into Christianity.
10. How many God’s did righteous Israel believe in?
Deuteronomy 6:4
Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD.
Note:

None of the Bible writers were trinitarians. The Bible was written by Jews who believed in only One True God. It is therefore dishonest to try to make the Bible teach what the writers of the Bible did not believe.
DREADFUL DAY OF THE LORD:
11. When Elijah returns prior to the dreadful day of the Lord, what will he turn the people back to?
Malachi 4:5
Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers.
Note:

When Elijah stood on Mount Carmel, he turned the children’s hearts to the God of their fathers. In the time of Elijah, Baal worship and true God worship became so close in appearances to each other, that Israel could not tell the difference between Jehovah and Baal. Baal worship also had priests, sacrifices, and temples. When Elijah asked Israel to choose whom they would serve, the people answered him not a word. (See 1 Kings 18:21) Israel had no clue that they had gradually entered into idolatry. It was only after God answered by fire that they exclaimed, “The Lord He is God”. (See 1 Kings 18:39)
Elijah’s message was also proclaimed at Christ’s first coming via John the Baptist. (See Matthew 11:14) He said, “I am the voice crying in the wilderness, make straight the way of the Lord.”

Elijah’s message will return once more before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord. (See Malachi 4:5) The “dreadful day of the Lord” is the second coming of Christ. Elijah’s final message will be similar to his message on Mount Carmel. On Carmel, Israel had two choices of who God was, and today, once again, we have to choose between two choices. We must choose between the three false gods of Babylon, and the worship of God and His Son.

Sadly, most do not realize how stealthily this worldwide false god system has invaded the Christian church. The reality is, the false-gods of Babylon have blinded us and tricked us into idol worship. Christianity has changed gods and does not realize that it has happened!
12. What signs will give power to Elijah’s message, prior to the dreadful day of the Lord?
Joel 2:28
And it shall come to pass afterward, that
I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit
And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke
The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
Note:

There will be a special outpouring of the Spirit of God at the end of time. This outpouring gives power to the three angels’ messages. This outpouring happens just prior to the “dreadful day of the Lord” (second coming).
BABYLON’S THREE-GOD DOCTRINE DENIES THAT GOD SENT HIS SON:
13. Whom did God send into the world?
John 3:16
For God so loved the world, that
he gave his only begotten Son,

that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life. 17 For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved. 18 He that believeth on him is not condemned:
but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God
Note:
The doctrine of
three co-eternal gods that make up one god
destroys the fact that God sent His Son. Most Christians will tell you that they believe what it says in John 3:16, but at the same time, they believe in Babylon’s
three-in-one, co-eternal god doctrine that teaches that Jesus is eternal
. If Jesus is eternal, then He would have always existed.
If Jesus has always existed, then there never was a time when He was begotten of the Father
. This is just another example of how over time, Babylon’s teachings have infiltrated the church and deny that God sent His actual Son. Babylon is indeed fallen!
This false teaching says that God did not send a real begotten Son.
It teaches that the words “begotten” and “son” are only metaphors

. But the Bible clearly teaches that Jesus is God’s literal Son! It calls Jesus the “Son of God” over 50 times! We can trust the Bible as it reads. God so loved the world that He gave His Son! (John 3:16)
He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
1 John 2:22)
TEN COMMANDMENTS ARE STILL VALID:
14. In contrast to Babylon, what do the saints keep?
Revelation 14:8
And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen
, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. 12
Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
Note:

Most Christian churches today teach that the Ten Commandments are no longer applicable to Christians. But the second angel’s message teaches that the saints at the end of time will be keeping God’s commandments.

Apostate Christianity breaks the first commandment by having other gods before the one true God. Christianity has also altered the fourth commandment by changing the Sabbath day to Sunday. These end-time heresies sow confusion similar to the confusion of ancient Babylon.
15. What is Christ able to cleanse us from?
1 John 1:9
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins,
and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Note:
The Ten Commandments are still in effect. (See Matthew 5:17-18) In fact, we will be judged by these commandments. (See James 2:12) We learned in tract #3, “
Walking in the Spiri
t” that God produces His fruit in our lives when we walk in the Spirit. This fruit is in harmony with God’s law of love.

Jesus says to some; “depart from me ye that work iniquity.” (Luke 13:27) Christians have the power of Christ available to live their life in harmony with the Ten Commandments, but many interpose their own perverse will, change God’s law, and frustrate His grace.
16. Who does the dragon make war with?
Revelation 12:17
And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and
went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Note:

In the last days, there will be people who will keep the commandments of God. But sinful Babylon will not be numbered with these commandment-keeping people. Sinful Babylon claims that the Ten Commandments have been nailed to the cross and are no longer valid. (See Tract 7, “
Nailed to the Cross.”
THIRD ANGEL… MARK OF THE BEAST:
17. How many nations have committed fornication with Babylon?
Revelation 18:3
For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her
Note:

Babylon is the apostate Christian church of the end times. She has committed fornication with the kings of the earth. We have recently seen churches receiving millions of government dollars by becoming government NGOs. Once addicted to this government money, it is hard to break the cycle, and of course there are always strings attached! We have also seen U.S. presidents praying with the leaders of apostate Christianity. These leaders are calling for a union between church and state. They want to tear down the wall of separation between the church and the state. Doing this could make a “spitting image” (idiom for exact likeness) to the persecution of the first beast of Revelation 13. (See Revelation 13:11-18)

The apostate Protestant churches have adopted Babylon’s errors in opposition to the God of the Bible! Will they eventually persecute those who stay true to the Bible? Only time will reveal how far modern Babylon is fallen.
Ancient Babylon fell because she tried to merge the religions of Babylonia. (See Wikipedia, “
Fall of Babylon.
”) Will modern Babylon once again try to merge all religions? The development of the modern ecumenical movement makes it seem so.
Revelation 14:8
Babylon is
fallen, is fallen.
Revelation 18:2
Babylon the great is f
allen, is fallen.
Isaiah 21:7
Babylon is
fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
18. What happens to those who receive the mark?
Revelation 14:8
Babylon is fallen is fallen
If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God
They have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name
Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
Note:
In these verses, four interconnected things are mentioned:
1. Fallen Babylon is mentioned.
2. The beast and his mark are mentioned.
3. Keeping the commandments of God is mentioned.
4. Worship is mentioned.

We won’t know the details of the mark of the beast until the scroll of the future is unrolled. But we do know that false worship is involved, and that no man will be able to buy or sell without the beast’s mark. (
Revelation 13:17 No man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.)
Babylon is fallen is fallen because; “
all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground
(See Isaiah 21:7) Babylon is fallen because of her idol worship. Rev 14:9 links Babylon to the mark of the beast.
19. Who does the second beast cause to worship?
Revelation 13:11
And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth
And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
Note:
The first beast persecuted the saints during the Dark Ages. (See Revelation 13:1-10) At the end of time there will arise (
another
), second beast that exercises the same persecuting power as the first beast before him.
He causes the earth and those who dwell therein to worship the first beast.
Revelation 13:12
The second beast will act identically to the former persecuting power of the first beast! It is this second beast that will, “
cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed
Revelation 13:15
God’s people will stand in contrast to this second beast and his mark. They will, “
keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
20. What does the voice from heaven call for us to do?
Revelation 18:4
And I heard another voice from heaven, saying,
Come out of her, my people
, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. 5.
For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
Note:
Her sins have reached unto heaven!”
